UPIC Pixel Blast adaptation — 2026-10-04

Official component:
https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/src/content/Backgrounds/PixelBlast/PixelBlast.jsx
Official showcase:
https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/src/demo/Backgrounds/PixelBlastDemo.jsx
Code-panel source:
https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/src/constants/code/Backgrounds/pixelBlastCode.js

The showcase imports the same component displayed in the code panel. Its
continuous movement comes from five-octave time-varying noise. Expanding rings
come from click events; pointer-liquid distortion is a separate optional effect.
The user's URL enables the default click ripples and leaves liquid disabled.

Reference parameters:
patternScale 0.25 / speed 1.35 / edgeFade 0.5 / density 1.65 / pixelSize 2.
License: see REACT-BITS-LICENSE.md in this directory.

UPIC retains noise/Bayer construction and ripple math with a shared market clock.
It is an adaptation, not an identical standalone demo. All pixels are squares.
The base square is 2 CSS pixels. A fixed 4 CSS-pixel lattice reserves room for
growth to 3.8 pixels without moving pixel centres or zooming the scene.
Physical cell boundaries and dot bounds are integer-aligned in both renderers.
Rendering is bounded to 1.2 million pixels; very large surfaces can use a lower
pixel ratio. Canvas visits cells rather than every image pixel.

Mappings:
- Market cap grows dot size and gradually reveals the coin image. Procedural
  noise remains present at high caps so the image cannot completely stop flow.
- Liquidity adjusts coverage around the 1.65 density baseline. A missing value
  is neutral; a known zero is sparse, not treated as missing.
- Fresh contextual movement, activity and volume shape speed around 1.35.
- Measured sound, instrument notes and Pd onsets add brief square-size accents.
- Significant market events trigger seeded ripples using the original ring math.
- Quiet playback retains small, weaker squares and settles movement to rest.
- EdgeFade 0.5 tapers square size spatially toward the perimeter. It does not
  fade the whole canvas or soften square edges.
- Spatial scale remains 0.25. No signal changes the camera or grid spacing.

Replay uses one relative presentation clock for noise and ripple age. Pausing
preserves phase, explicit seeks reset it, and candle-speed playback passes the
actual chart rate. Reduced-motion preference freezes flow and suppresses pulses.

Read source and reviewed changes statically. No browser or device audition was
performed for this revision.
